subject: compiling stan after changing a source file

messages.author: 356e10cb28b86ae4
messages.subject: compiling stan after changing a source file
parts: I'm having a problem compiling Stan 1.0.3 after modifying a source file (~/stan-src-1.0.3/src/stan/gm/command.hpp). After invoking make bin/libstan.a and make bin/stanc, make replies that the targets are up to date, which is unexpected. Shouldn't make see that there is a file which has changed and then recompile that file? What am I doing wrong? Of course, I can run make clean-all, and then recompile everything, but that is too slow. Thanks in advance for any ideas you may have.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] compiling stan after changing a source file
parts:
The makefile behavior in this case is correct. The generated model
needs to be recompiled when gm/command.hpp changes, not bin/stanc.
That means, if you have model.stan, model.cpp is going to be the same
before and after changes to gm/command.hpp.


Daniel
